# Summary

The conversation involved removing kanban column assignment functionality from a Vue-based PR review system. The user requested elimination of the ability to bulk-set file columns through a dropdown UI in the Chat and PRView components. Changes were made across four main files (PRFile.vue, PRReport.vue, PRView.vue, and Chat.vue) to remove column selection dropdowns, event handlers, and related methods. The simplified workflow now relies solely on inheriting the column from the parent chat's properties rather than allowing dynamic reassignment. This streamlines the PR review process by reducing UI complexity and making column management more predictable.
